{{recipesummary|category=Beverage recipes|servings=1|time=5 minutes|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverage]]

'''Yoda Soda''' is a fun drink that looks like Master Yoda's head.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Mountain Dew [[Cookbook:Soda Pop|soda]] (or any yellowish-green soda you like)

*2 scoops [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of chocolate [[Cookbook:Sprinkles|sprinkles]]

== Procedure ==
#Fill glass with soda.
#Add ice cream.
#Drop a few chocolate sprinkles on the ice cream to look like hair.
